question.problem:
Consider the quadratic form 
$Q(x)={x}_{1}^{2}+2{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-2{x}_{1}{x}_{3}+2{x}_{3}^{2}.$ 
Evaluate $Q(x)$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Substituting this into the expression for $Q(x)$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}_{1}^{2}+2{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-2{x}_{1}{x}_{3}+2{x}_{3}^{2} \\  & ={1}^{2}+2\cdot 1\cdot 1-2\cdot 1\cdot (-3)+2\cdot (-3)^{2} \\  & =1+2+6+18 \\  & =27.\end{aligned}
$$
